record.original_question: Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold of codimension q and E a vector bundle on M. Is every operator P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) contained in the weak trace ideal L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), with Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) independent of the choice of invariant mean omega and equal to the residue trace tau(P)?

evidence.quote: A similar relation of the Dixmier trace Tr_omega with the transverse Riemannian volume form associated with a Riemannian foliation relies on the following conjecture...

Conjecture 5.9. Let (M, F) be a compact foliated manifold and E a vector bundle on M. Any P in Psi^{-q,-infinity}(M, F, E) (q = codim F) belongs to L^{1+}(L^2(M, E)), the Dixmier trace Tr_omega(P) does not depend on the choice of omega and coincides with the value of the residue trace tau(P).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\mathcal{F})$ be a smooth compact foliated manifold of codimension $q$, and let $E\to M$ be a smooth complex vector bundle. Consider the bifiltered algebra $\Psi^{*,*}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ of (transversal) pseudodifferential operators adapted to the foliation, where the first index records the transverse order and the second index the longitudinal order. Denote by $\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ the class of operators of transverse order $-q$ and longitudinal order $-\infty$. On the Hilbert space $L^2(M,E)$, denote by $\mathcal{L}^{1,\infty}$ the Dixmier (weak trace) ideal, consisting of compact operators $T$ whose singular values $\mu_n(T)$ satisfy $\sum_{n\le N}\mu_n(T) = O(\log N)$, and for $T\in\mathcal{L}^{1,\infty}_+$ let $\mathrm{Tr}_\omega(T)$ denote the Dixmier trace associated with an invariant mean $\omega$ on $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N})$. Let $\tau$ denote the residue (noncommutative residue) trace defined on $\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$.

Prove or disprove: every $P\in\Psi^{-q,-\infty}(M,\mathcal{F},E)$ belongs to $\mathcal{L}^{1,\infty}(L^2(M,E))$, the value $\mathrm{Tr}_\omega(P)$ is independent of the choice of invariant mean $\omega$, and
$$\mathrm{Tr}_\omega(P) \;=\; \tau(P).$$
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface Kordyukov's surveys and related works on transversally elliptic operators, Dixmier traces, and noncommutative residues on foliated manifolds, but no source explicitly resolves the stated conjecture identifying the Dixmier trace with the residue trace on Ψ^{-q,-∞}(M,F,E). Recent refinements of Connes' trace theorem (e.g., Kordyukov–Sukochev–Zanin and follow-ups) treat related settings, yet a definitive proof or disproof of this specific conjecture was not located.

status_evidence.title: Index theory and non-commutative geometry on foliated manifolds (Russian Math. Surveys 64:2)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of index theory and noncommutative geometry on foliated manifolds, discussing Dixmier trace and residue-type extensions for transversal pseudodifferential calculi.
status_evidence.claim: Survey by Kordyukov discusses the framework but does not record a proof of the residue=Dixmier identification for Ψ^{-q,-∞}(M,F,E).

status_evidence.title: Noncommutative Geometry, Spectral Asymptotics, and Semiclassical Analysis
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work refining Connes' trace theorem and extensions by Kordyukov–Sukochev–Zanin.
